name: add_healthcheck_to_compose
description: Adds a healthcheck block to the web service in docker-compose.yml
prompts: docker-compose.yml defines an 'app' service and a 'db' service, but 'app' has no healthcheck, so orchestration tools can't tell when it's actually ready. Add a healthcheck to the 'app' service that runs `curl -f http://localhost:80/health`, checks every 30 seconds, times out after 10 seconds, and retries 3 times before marking the container unhealthy. Do not remove or change any existing configuration.

setup_files.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://appuser:apppass@db:5432/appdb
    depends_on:
      - db
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=appuser
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=apppass
      - POSTGRES_DB=appdb

test_setup_files.test_compose.py:
import yaml

with open('docker-compose.yml') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

services = data.get('services') or {}
assert 'app' in services, f'app service missing, got {list(services)}'
app = services['app']

hc = app.get('healthcheck')
assert isinstance(hc, dict), f"app service must have a 'healthcheck' mapping, got {hc!r}"

test = hc.get('test')
assert test, "healthcheck must define a 'test' command"
test_str = ' '.join(test) if isinstance(test, list) else str(test)
assert 'health' in test_str.lower(), f"healthcheck test should hit the /health endpoint, got {test_str!r}"
assert ('curl' in test_str.lower()) or ('wget' in test_str.lower()), f"healthcheck test should use curl or wget, got {test_str!r}"

assert hc.get('interval'), "healthcheck must set an 'interval'"
assert hc.get('retries'), "healthcheck must set 'retries'"
retries = int(hc.get('retries'))
assert retries >= 1, f"healthcheck retries should be >= 1, got {retries}"

# existing config must survive
assert app.get('image') == 'myorg/webapp:latest', f"app image changed unexpectedly: {app.get('image')!r}"
depends_on = app.get('depends_on') or []
if isinstance(depends_on, dict):
    depends_on = list(depends_on.keys())
assert 'db' in depends_on, f"app depends_on was removed: {depends_on}"

print('PASS')

reference_solution.docker-compose.yml:
version: "3.9"
services:
  app:
    image: myorg/webapp:latest
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      - DATABASE_URL=postgresql://appuser:apppass@db:5432/appdb
    depends_on:
      - db
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://localhost:80/health"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 10s
      retries: 3
  db:
    image: postgres:15
    ports:
      - "5432:5432"
    environment:
      - POSTGRES_USER=appuser
      - POSTGRES_PASSWORD=apppass
      - POSTGRES_DB=appdb
